rows.fund_name: what every fund column asserts about itself
rows.proof:
The combined balance sheet, six fund columns. Every identity the page states about itself closes in every column: the assets foot to TOTAL ASSETS, the liabilities to TOTAL LIABILITIES, the fund balances to TOTAL FUND EQUITY, and liabilities plus equity equals assets. The long-term debt column prints its totals rounded to the dollar and ties within one.
IT DISAGREES WITH ANOTHER TABLE IN THE SAME REPORT, and that is recorded rather than resolved: special revenue equity 6,131,303.68 plus enterprise equity 3,812,502.24 is 9,943,805.92, where the FY2023 special revenue schedule prints a grand total carried forward of 10,031,099.78 -- 87,293.86 apart, on a comparison that ties to the cent in FY2011, FY2013, FY2019 and FY2022. WHICH TABLE IS RIGHT IS NOT ESTABLISHED. This page is not wrong for it; its own arithmetic is complete.

rows.fund_name: what every department asserts about itself
rows.reconciliation: page 33, the row `GRAND TOTAL`: appropriated 48,218,697.29 vs printed 48,218,697.29 ; available 48,218,697.29 vs printed 48,218,697.29 ; balance 588,682.97 vs printed 588,682.97 ; encumbered 323,853.92 vs printed 323,853.92 ; expended 47,306,160.4 vs printed 47,306,160.4
rows.proof: The general fund appropriations, seven pages, 83 departments. Two identities, and both close: every department returns available less expended less encumbered as its balance to revenue, 83 of 83; and all five columns sum across the seven pages to the GRAND TOTAL printed on p33 -- 48,218,697.29 appropriated and available, 47,306,160.40 expended, 323,853.92 encumbered, 588,682.97 balance. Line items are transcribed beneath each department total and are not summed here, because the page folds a department’s FORWARD into its appropriated column in most places and prints it outside in two.
